verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The scheduled certification remains correct, fail-closed, and non-vacuously tested. The certified set follows every role-producing derivation rung and independently accounts for the planner's non-role writes plus the quarantine producer. Empty label input is refused, missing labels are named with a non-zero result, the job has read-only label permissions, and the exact workflow step is executed against both complete and deficient repositories. I found no diff-supported correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue requiring changes.
